calls.reason: The comparison is explicitly hedged. Artificial Analysis found better performance and fewer output tokens, while Anthropic disclosed increased input token counts; token evidence varies by category.
Epoch documents Stargate construction, but Anthropic's agreements describe future capacity without matching construction phases. Neither establishes both allocations within the stated 15.2GW.
CBRE documents deployment constraints, and NVIDIA discloses infrastructure risks. Neither compares actual GPU sales with feasible installations or establishes an accumulating warehouse backlog.

Gamma reports over two years of profitability after scaling with only $23 million in initial funding. Although self-reported and undefined, this points against the blanket assertion of hundreds of millions in losses.
GitHub confirms restrictions and computational pressure, but the near-doubling figure traces back to Zitron. No independent cost comparison establishes that magnitude or its causal role.
The productivity and customer-loss claims are hedged. The developer trial found a slowdown while retail experiments found gains; neither settles broad provider profitability or customer net returns.
